title: "iSRL Receives Nagarathna Memorial Grant 2026"
date: "2026-04-22"
categories: [Announcement, Grant]
description: "We are grateful to receive the Nagarathna Memorial Grant for our work on the Indian Food ID (IFID)."
---

We are excited to announce that iSRL has been awarded the **Nagarathna Memorial Grant 2026** for our work on the **Indian Food ID (IFID)**.

This support directly fuels our mission to build a **coordination layer** for Indian packaged food data. Currently, the lack of a shared understanding of ingredients—where "groundnut oil" and "arachis oil" are seen as unrelated by machines—creates a landscape where data cleaning is half the job and nutrition studies sit on shaky ground. 

IFID is building a **deterministic ingredient substrate**—a canonical reference that makes the ecosystem legible to machines, regulators, and researchers without requiring the ecosystem to change or flattening the inherent diversity of India's food traditions.

We would like to express our sincere gratitude to **Thejesh GN** for organizing this micro-grant and to the **FOSS United Foundation** for their significant support. This funding is a vital contribution to our efforts in building open, neutral, and high-quality data infrastructure for the Indian food system.

Read more about the grant results [here](https://thejeshgn.com/2026/04/22/nagarathna-memorial-grant-2026-results/).
